title: First shoes, then swing

cards.label: Put on shoes
cards.imagePrompt: Flat vector icon, plain white background, no detail: a child's sneakers

cards.label: Swing
cards.imagePrompt: Flat vector icon, plain white background, no detail: a playground swing

plan.reinforcement: Deliver the swing immediately. Do not delay or substitute.
plan.placement: By the front door, at the child's eye level.
plan.ifChallengingBehavior: Keep prompting the FIRST task. Stay on the task, not the behavior. Then still give the swing.

citations: TRIAD Visual Supports and Autism (2011), First-Then Board
